pairs: Behold, the king will reign in justice,
and the princes will rule in judgment.
Et erit vir sicut qui absconditur a vento,
And a man will be like someone hidden from the wind,
who conceals himself from a storm,
or like rivers of waters in a time of thirst,
et umbra petræ prominentis in terra deserta.
or like the shadow of a rock that juts out in a desert land.
The eyes of those who see will not be obscured,
and the ears of those who hear will listen closely.
And the heart of the foolish will understand knowledge,
et lingua balborum velociter loquetur et plane.
and the tongue of those with impaired speech will speak quickly and plainly.
Non vocabitur ultra is qui insipiens est, princeps,
He who is foolish will no longer be called leader,
nor will the deceitful be called greater.
stultus enim fatua loquetur, et cor ejus faciet iniquitatem, ut perficiat simulationem,
For a foolish man speaks foolishness and his heart works iniquity in order to accomplish deception.
And he speaks to the Lord deceitfully,
et vacuam faciat animam esurientis, et potum sitienti auferat.
so as to empty the soul of the hungry and to take away drink from the thirsty.
The tools of the deceitful are very wicked.
ipse enim cogitationes concinnavit ad perdendos mites in sermone mendacii,
For they have concocted plans to destroy the meek by lying words,
Princeps vero ea quæ digna sunt principe cogitabit,
Yet truly, the prince will plan things that are worthy of a prince,
and he will stand above the rulers.
play close attention to my eloquence!
For after a year and some days,
you who are confident will be disturbed.
For the vintage has been completed;
the gathering will no longer occur.
Super humum populi mei spinæ et vepres ascendent:
Thorn and brier will rise up, over the soil of my people.
quanto magis super omnes domos gaudii civitatis exultantis!
How much more over all the houses of gladness, over the city of exultation?
For the house has been forsaken.
The multitude of the city has been abandoned.
tenebræ et palpatio factæ sunt super speluncas usque in æternum;
A darkness and a covering have been placed over its dens,
It will be the gladness of wild donkeys and the pasture of flocks,
Donec effundatur super nos spiritus de excelso,
until the Spirit is poured over us from on high.
And the desert will be a fruitful field,
and the fruitful field will be considered as a forest.
And judgment will live in solitude,
and justice will be seated in a fruitful place.
And the work of justice will be peace.
And the service of justice will be quiet and secure,
Et sedebit populus meus in pulchritudine pacis,
And my people will be seated in the beauty of peacefulness,
and in the tabernacles of faithfulness,
and in the opulence of restfulness.
But hail will be in the descent of the forest,
and the city will be brought exceedingly low.
Beati qui seminatis super omnes aquas,
Blessed are you who sow over any waters,
sending the feet of the ox and the donkey there.
